units.source_text: 岛村不知为什么，很想再强调一声“完全是一种徒劳嘛”，就在此时，

en.t: For some reason, Shimamura wanted very much to emphasize once more, "It is all utterly futile," and just then,
the stillness of the snowy night sank deep into him,

units.source_text: 那是因为被女子吸引住了。

en.t: and that was because he had been drawn in by the woman.
